text: Unit testing PySpark transformations — the first kind of test from last lesson, in full depth.
A function that reads a file and transforms it is hard to test. A function that just takes a dataframe in and returns one out is easy — you hand it exactly the test data you want.
A local spark session runs on a single thread — no cluster, no fabric workspace, no network call. That's what makes it fast enough to run dozens of times, every single commit.
A full pipeline test tells you the whole thing worked or didn't. A unit test isolates one function — when it fails, you already know exactly where the bug is.
Fast, precise, and cheap to run constantly. Next up: data contracts — a promise about shape, enforced automatically.
